name: Meta AI Vibes
desc: Feed for creating and sharing short AI-generated videos
desc_zh: 创建并分享 AI 短视频的信息流
solves: AI video clips were scattered across social feeds; Vibes puts an endless stream of them inside the Meta AI app.
solves_zh: AI 视频散落在各个社交信息流里，Vibes 把它们集中到 Meta AI 应用的一个信息流中。
best_for: You have ten minutes to kill and want to remix a trending AI clip.
best_for_zh: 有十分钟空闲，想随手改编一条正在流行的 AI 视频。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C — https://techcrunch.com/tag/meta-ai/ (then D: about.fb.com post sitemap)）。 Outside the window. Early preview in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai; an in-product surface of Meta AI (in the ledger at 2025-04-29), not a separate app. Brought to Europe in November 2025. meta.ai returns HTTP 403 to a plain HTTP client but loaded through the fetch tool. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Vibes」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://about.fb.com/news/2025/09/introducing-vibes-ai-videos/
